meta.summary: A grid with columns and no rows.

mkp-data:datagrid@1.name: datagrid
mkp-data:datagrid@1.about: Records under a header row: columns aligned and monospaced, rows and cells marked with a glyph and a word in a tone, a legend of the marks, a side pane whose items light the rows that have them, and an optional current row that steps through the rows and plays.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: the header's title

inputs.name: kind
inputs.about: what kind of thing it is, said small before the title

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: the table's name, over its rows

inputs.name: cols
inputs.about: the columns: a heading, its alignment, monospaced, a badge after the heading (FK), lit as the sort key, a rule on its left, and its share of the width (out of 12 with the ids and notes; 0 in every column: by what they hold)

inputs.name: rows
inputs.about: the rows: an id, a cell per column, a mark (the id of one of the marks) and a note at the end

inputs.name: marks
inputs.about: the legend: what a mark means; a row with it is washed in its tone and shows its glyph, or is struck through when the mark is struck

inputs.name: values
inputs.about: cells washed by what they say; muted shows the value faded instead (off, unset, NULL)

inputs.name: cellmarks
inputs.about: single cells marked, by row id and column heading: a glyph, what it means, a tone (a wash, or an outline)

inputs.name: ids
inputs.about: the gutter of row ids: small keys, names, or no gutter

inputs.name: idhead
inputs.about: the gutter's heading

inputs.name: side
inputs.about: a side pane's title: its items are the values of the column `match`, and picking one lights the rows that have it

inputs.name: match
inputs.about: the column the side pane's items come from

inputs.name: hint
inputs.about: what the bar says while nothing is picked

inputs.name: follow
inputs.about: step through the rows: the current one is lit, the ones passed take the mark `done`, and the bar plays it

inputs.name: start
inputs.about: the row it starts at, from 0

inputs.name: done
inputs.about: the mark a passed row takes

inputs.name: pending
inputs.about: the columns whose cells read — until their row is passed

inputs.name: verb
inputs.about: the status while following: the verb, the row's id, its cells

inputs.name: window
inputs.about: how many rows show at once while following, kept around the current one (0: all)

inputs.name: height
inputs.about: the stage's height; none fits the rows

inputs.name: key
inputs.about: a legend of the marks under the rows (marks without a glyph are left out)

values.name: tonewash
values.body: if(t == "ok", ok, if(t == "warn", warn, if(t == "bad", bad, if(t == "info", info, if(t == "muted", muted, if(t == "accent", accent, surface))))))

values.name: auto

value.expr: fold(cols, true, (a, c) => a and c.width == 0)

comment: shares of the width (a grid of at most 12 columns): as given, or, when no column gives one, by how
much each column has to say (monospaced text is wider), with room for padding and glyphs

values.name: longest
values.body: fold(rows, 0, (a, r) => max(a, len(at(r.cells, c, ""))))

values.name: chars
values.body: max(len(cols[c].label) * 1.1 + if(cols[c].badge == "", 0, len(cols[c].badge) + 4) + if(cols[c].lit, 2, 0), longest(c) * if(cols[c].mono, 1.3, 1) + if(len(filter(cellmarks, m => m.col == cols[c].label and m.glyph != "")) > 0, 3, 0)) + 3
comment: a column with a marked cell keeps room for its glyph

value.expr: if(gutter, fold(rows, len(idhead), (a, r) => max(a, len(r.id))) * if(ids == keys, 1.15, 1.3) + if(len(marks) > 0, 3, 0) + 3, 0)
if(notes, min(28, fold(rows, 0, (a, r) => max(a, len(r.note)))) * 0.85 + 3, 0)

values.name: needs
comment: the columns' weights, then the gutter's and the notes' (0 when there are none), shared out of 12
a grid that has little to say still spans the pane: the slack goes to the notes, or else to the
last column of text that starts at the left

value.expr: filter(range(0, n - 1), c => "" + cols[c].align == "start" and not cols[c].mono)
map(range(0, n + 1), i => needs[i] + if(i == filler, slack, 0))

values.name: floors
comment: when there is slack, the column taking it takes what the rounding leaves too, so a gutter or a
short column keeps the share it asked for

value.expr: fold(range(0, n + 1), 0, (a, i) => a + if(i == filler, 0, floors[i]))
if(slack > 0, map(range(0, n + 1), i => if(i == filler, max(1, 12 - rest), floors[i])), gridshares(weights))
map(range(0, n - 1), c => if(auto, shares[c], if(cols[c].width == 0, 2, cols[c].width)))
fold(asked, 0, (a, w) => a + w) + gasked + nasked
max(1, min(12, if(fit, widths, n + if(gutter, 1, 0) + if(notes, 1, 0))))

values.name: wide
values.body: if(fit, asked[c], 1)

values.name: spans
comment: the least width, in characters: where the tightest column (not the one taking the slack) just
fits its share, and no less than what all of them have to say

value.expr: fold(range(0, n + 1), 0, (a, i) => if(i == filler or spans[i] == 0, a, max(a, needs[i] * across / spans[i])))
join(map(range(1, max(1, round(0.8 max(tightest, fold(needs, 0, (a, w) => a + w))))), i => " "), "")

values.name: mglyph
values.body: at(map(filter(marks, m => m.id == id), m => m.glyph), 0, "")
comment: a mark, by its id ("" is none)

values.name: mlabel
values.body: at(map(filter(marks, m => m.id == id), m => m.label), 0, "")

values.name: mtone
values.body: at(map(filter(marks, m => m.id == id), m => "" + m.tone), 0, "")

values.name: mstruck
values.body: at(map(filter(marks, m => m.id == id), m => m.struck), 0, false)

values.name: mi
comment: a row: its mark now, current, lit from the side pane, struck, and its wash

values.name: mark
values.body: if(follow and k < pos and done != "", done, rows[k].mark)

values.name: current
values.body: follow and k == pos

values.name: linked
values.body: pick != "" and at(rows[k].cells, mi, "") == pick

values.name: struck
values.body: mstruck(mark(k))

values.name: rwash
values.body: if(current(k) or linked(k), "info", if(struck(k), "", mtone(mark(k))))

values.name: pend
values.body: follow and k >= pos and indexof(pending, labels[c]) >= 0
comment: a cell: what it says now, its mark, the tone its value gives it, and its wash

values.name: raw
values.body: if(pend(k, c), "—", at(rows[k].cells, c, ""))

values.name: cms
values.body: filter(cellmarks, m => m.row == rows[k].id and m.col == labels[c])

values.name: vtone
values.body: at(map(filter(values, v => v.value == raw(k, c)), v => "" + v.tone), 0, "")

values.name: faded
values.body: pend(k, c) or vtone(k, c) == "muted"

values.name: ctone
values.body: at(map(cms(k, c), m => "" + m.tone), 0, "")

values.name: outlined
values.body: at(map(cms(k, c), m => m.outline), 0, false)

values.name: cwash
values.body: if(current(k) or linked(k) or struck(k), rwash(k), if(len(cms(k, c)) > 0 and not outlined(k, c), ctone(k, c), if(vtone(k, c) != "" and vtone(k, c) != "muted", vtone(k, c), rwash(k))))

values.name: dcell
values.body: {v: raw(k, c), wash: cwash(k, c), tone: if(faded(k, c), "muted", "ink"), glyph: at(map(cms(k, c), m => m.glyph), 0, ""), gtone: ctone(k, c), outline: outlined(k, c), mono: cols[c].mono or faded(k, c), align: cols[c].align, span: wide(c), rule: cols[c].divider}

values.name: first

value.expr: if(follow and window > 0, max(0, min(len(rows) - window, pos - 1)), 0)

comment: the rows shown: all, or a window kept around the current one; the last is faded when more follow

value.expr: if(follow and window > 0, min(len(rows) - 1, first + window - 1), len(rows) - 1)

values.name: drawn
values.body: {id: rows[k].id, key: ids == keys, glyph: mglyph(mark(k)), gtone: mtone(mark(k)), gspan: gspan, wash: rwash(k), struck: struck(k), current: current(k), bar: follow, dim: follow and window > 0 and k == last and last < len(rows) - 1, note: rows[k].note, nspan: nspan, across: across, cells: map(range(0, n - 1), c => dcell(k, c))}

value.expr: map(range(0, n - 1), c => {label: cols[c].label, align: cols[c].align, badge: cols[c].badge, lit: cols[c].lit, span: wide(c), rule: cols[c].divider})

values.name: items

value.expr: if(mi < 0, [], fold(rows, [], (xs, r) => if(indexof(xs, at(r.cells, mi, "")) >= 0, xs, xs + [at(r.cells, mi, "")])))

comment: the side pane's items: the column's values in order of first appearance

values.name: says
values.body: join(filter(map(range(0, n - 1), c => if(pend(k, c), "", at(rows[k].cells, c, ""))), v => v != ""), " · ")

value.expr: if(follow and len(rows) > 0, verb + " **" + rows[pos].id + "** · " + says(pos), if(side == "", "", if(pick == "", hint, "**" + pick + "** · " + lit + " of " + len(rows) + " rows")))

values.name: mdcell
values.body: at(rows[k].cells, c, "") + at(map(cms(k, c), m => " " + m.glyph + if(m.label == "", "", " (" + m.label + ")")), 0, "")

values.name: mdrow
values.body: map(if(gutter, [rows[k].id + if(rows[k].mark == "", "", " " + mglyph(rows[k].mark) + " " + mlabel(rows[k].mark))], []) + map(range(0, n - 1), c => mdcell(k, c)) + if(notes, [rows[k].note], []), x => if(mstruck(rows[k].mark) and x != "", "~~" + x + "~~", x))

comment: a row holding the table, so a pane narrower than the table scrolls sideways instead of
squeezing its cells over each other: a blank line of figure spaces (they don't break) sets
the least width, from how much the columns have to say

md.expr:
if(name == "", "", "**" + name + "**

") + mdtable(if(gutter, [if(idhead == "", "id", idhead)], []) + labels + if(notes, ["note"], []), map(range(0, len(rows) - 1), k => mdrow(k))) + if(len(marks) == 0, "", "
" + join(map(marks, m => m.glyph + " " + m.label), " · ") + "
